mutants.description: Treat zero as no inset instead of half a nozzle diameter for either source. Both zero-sentinel geometry comparisons must fail while their positive-inset controls remain unchanged.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Nil filament ironing spacing inherits process geometry
mutants.description: Replace only the nil-override fallback with a finite 0.1 mm constant. The explicit 0.4 mm same-as-process and 0.2 mm distinct-override controls remain intact; the nil row must stop matching the configured 0.4 mm process ironing length. This avoids zero or sub-floor spacing values.
